grouped-region.name: Regional: Grouped by Species, then Forms
grouped-region.description: Pokémon Boxes are sorted by Species only, following the game's Pokédex order. Forms are grouped at the end by category.

fully-sorted.name: Regional: Sorted by Species and Forms
fully-sorted.description: Pokémon Boxes are sorted by Species and Forms together, following the game's Pokédex order.

fully-sorted-no-cosmetic-forms.name: Regional: Sorted by Species and Forms (Except Cosmetic Forms)
fully-sorted-no-cosmetic-forms.description: Pokémon Boxes are sorted by Species and Forms together (except cosmetic forms), following the game's Pokédex order.

fully-sorted-no-forms.name: Regional: Sorted by Species (No Forms)
fully-sorted-no-forms.description: Pokémon Boxes are sorted by Species only (no forms), following the game's Pokédex order.
